title: Lane lint runs the hooks test suites that load a file the lane changed
why: `merge --lane-lint` and `ci-job checks --lint` run no hooks/test_*.py suite, so a hooks/ fixture change that breaks another hooks suite reaches the batch. That happened with #1678: test_wrappers.py split cases, and the batch dropped #1794 (coordinator, 02:04 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: lane lint also runs each hooks/test_*.py suite that imports or loads a file the diff touches. Bound it within decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job (touched tests only, never the full run), and state the cost in the record (suites run, process starts, per lane lint). Red case first: a diff that touches a hooks fixture another suite loads, and today's lane lint passes it. Control: a diff that touches no hooks file runs no hooks suite.
